task.description:
WF-03 Step 0.5 — ISSUE-FIXER: registry lookup + GitHub filing verification

ISS-0129 is already filed on GitHub as tvolodi/R-Co#419 (confirmed via `gh issue view 419`). Your job in this step:

1. **Confirm ID collision check.** `gh issue list --search "1135 deadlock TC-TNT-01-01" --state all` — verify the only match is #419 itself. (Local ISS-0129 numbering must not collide with an unrelated existing GitHub issue; we already saw only #419 matches, but confirm in case other issues share keywords.)

2. **Verify the local ISS-0129 record has github_issue set.** Read `docs/issues/ISS-0129.json` and confirm `"github_issue": "https://github.com/tvolodi/R-Co/issues/419"` is set. If not, write it in (preserve all other fields exactly). If it IS already set, no write needed.

3. **Cross-check the issue_index** at `docs/issues/issue_index.json` (if it exists) for any existing entry referencing #419 or ISS-0129. If absent, add one. If present, leave it.

4. **Verify the GitHub issue is still OPEN** and labels include `bug`. Run `gh issue view 419 --json state,labels`. If labels are missing `bug`, do NOT add labels — that's outside this agent's scope (file a separate note if you observe a discrepancy).

5. **Do NOT modify issue body content.** This step is verification only. The diagnosis + fix design will be in subsequent handoffs.

Return PASS with a short report:
  - gh issue 419 state and labels
  - whether docs/issues/ISS-0129.json needed github_issue written in (yes/no)
  - whether docs/issues/issue_index.json needed updating (yes/no, and what you wrote)
  - any MINOR observations (e.g., the candidate_resolution in the issue body is technically incorrect — see Step 1)
acceptance_criteria: issue_index.json is consistent with this ISS
No ID collision with unrelated GitHub issues

result.summary: Verified GH #419 is OPEN, labeled bug, and tagged <!-- rco-sync-ref: ISS-0129 -->. No ID collision: only #419 matches the '1135 deadlock TC-TNT-01-01' search on GitHub. Local docs/issues/ISS-0129.json already had github_issue set; no write needed. docs/issues/issue_index.json already lists ISS-0129 with github_issue pointing at #419; no update needed. MINOR observation: the GitHub body mirrors the original ISS JSON snapshot (which had github_issue=null at filing time); the local file has since been corrected but the GitHub body is stale on that single field. No action this step (per task: do NOT modify issue body content).
